purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and schema-first anonymous geometry review.
assessment: Official district administration identifies an Arazi Record Center in Rahim Yar Khan tehsil. Punjab’s public map is village-wise and presents district/tehsil/village selectors, but no feature schema or safe query fields were verified. The city point was not resolved to a map extent; no lookup was made. The public cadastral map is village-selected and its anonymous geometry/schema contract is unknown. No personal or parcel-specific lookup was performed.
registryAssessment: The Rahim Yar Khan district administration’s Revenue Department page lists one Arazi Record Center for Rahim Yar Khan tehsil and five across the district; the page also identifies revenue estates and local revenue administration. Punjab’s official land-record portal exposes a village-wise cadastral-map selector. The public selector reveals no safe feature schema and includes separate owner/record search functions; no parcel or owner lookup was submitted.
